name: yahwehsworld
description: A 3D globe of the biblical world — every place Scripture names, placed as honestly as the evidence allows.

scripts.build: npm run shell && npm run zh && npm run events && npm run bible && npm run gallery-data && node scripts/build-version.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:gallery: npm run reader:data && VITE_SURFACE=gallery npm run build
scripts.verify:gallery: npm run test:gallery && node scripts/check-budget.mjs --profile gallery && node scripts/verify-gallery.mjs && node scripts/verify-redirects.mjs && node scripts/verify-gallery-ui.mjs && node scripts/verify-ru.mjs
scripts.test:routes: node scripts/verify-routes.mjs && node scripts/verify-route-behavior.mjs && node scripts/verify-route-network.mjs
scripts.app:dist: VITE_SURFACE=gallery VITE_TARGET=shell VITE_OUT_DIR=dist-shell npm run build && node scripts/shell-dist.mjs
